label: WhatsApp Fetch Media (Baileys)
description: Pull one message's media (a voice note, a picture, a document) out of the project's WhatsApp bridge into storage, by its `messageId`. The message has to be one the bridge still holds: a live message BaileyReceive already stores for you; this is for one out of BaileyFetchMessages history, whose entries carry the id but not the bytes.

inputs.name: messageId
inputs.description: The `messageId` of a media message, as a BaileyFetchMessages entry or a BaileyReceive fire carries it.
